recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle - and covered two serious milestone (pay-in-phases) money bugs found and fixed on day one. Day 2 (June 26, 2026) covered a three-layer WhatsApp notification bug hunt: buyers stopped getting told their payment was ready to release, with each fix (a 24h-messaging-window bypass, then a phone-number-format mismatch, then a wrong Supabase count API) uncovering a deeper silent failure underneath the last. Day 3 (later June 26, 2026) shipped a 'resume TXN-CODE' command letting users jump back into a stalled deal from any of the six bots or from email, then closed the final gap in the notification saga by making the send function report honest success/failure instead of assuming it worked. Day 4 (also June 26, 2026) fixed a milestone phase-numbering bug where notification emails showed the wrong phase (e.g. 'Phase 3' instead of 'Phase 1', and 'Milestone 0 of 3') because the code inferred the phase number from database list order instead of the stored index - two small off-by-order/off-by-one bugs with real trust cost. Day 5 (also June 26, 2026, later that evening) swapped generic placeholder icons for real OPay/Flutterwave/crypto-rail brand logos on the payment modal to build buyer trust, immediately broke the platform-fee display by deleting a still-used import in the same cleanup pass, then fixed it and bumped a logo's size minutes later - a tight, honest loop of shipping, breaking, and fixing solo. Next chapter picks up with the start of a big admin dashboard expansion.
